# Érica Menin

> Design Systems Lead with 15+ years in design. Érica makes design system decisions easier for people and AI to find, apply, and trust: audits, Figma and code alignment, tokens, component guidance, documentation, and AI workflows.

Érica Menin (ericamenin.com) is based in Germany and works remotely with distributed teams. Her focus is design systems that are read by two audiences: the people who build products, and the AI tools that now read tokens, rules, and docs and guess where context is missing. She works on making that knowledge explicit, without rebuilding everything first.

She has led multi-team design system work at Mews, covering design tokens, Figma Variables and Libraries, documentation, adoption, and collaboration between design and engineering.

Contact: erica@menin.me · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ericamenin/)

## Expertise

- Design system audits and cross-platform alignment (Figma, React, Flutter)
- Design systems for people and AI: explicit rules, component guidance in code, READMEs
- AI workflows for design system teams (skills, Cursor commands)
- Design Systems strategy and maturity
- Design tokens and token architecture
- Figma Variables, Libraries, and scalable workflows
- Component libraries and governance models
- Design-engineering collaboration
- Design system documentation and education
- Design operations and system adoption

## Work (case studies and recent work)

Érica's recent work focuses on keeping design systems aligned across design and code, and legible to both people and AI.

A summary of her recent design system work, learnings, and experiments is available in:

- [Getting a design system back in sync](https://ericamenin.com/design-system-back-in-sync.html): A case study on auditing 62 components across Figma, React, and Flutter, and modernising the Figma foundations of a multi-platform design system through variables, theming, and an incremental migration.

- [Maturing a design system beyond components](https://ericamenin.com/maturing-design-system.html): A 2025 review covering the evolution of a design system through design tokens, variables, governance, patterns, adoption, and AI-enabled workflows.

This article provides an overview of Érica's recent work. Additional details, case studies, and examples from enterprise design system initiatives are available through direct contact.

- [24 days of Design System Experiments](https://ericamenin.com/24-days-design-system-experiments.html): A write-up of an AI-assisted design system experiment featuring 24 activities, prompts, and challenges exploring systems thinking, patterns, components, and design decisions.

- [The Design System Advent Calendar](https://ericamenin.com/design-system-calendar.html): The interactive AI-assisted experience behind the 24-day experiment series, combining Érica's design system expertise with generative AI to create guided learning activities.

## Writing

- [Design Systems Unfiltered](https://designsystemsunfiltered.substack.com/): Érica's publication sharing practical insights on building, scaling, and evolving design systems, including strategy, governance, workflows, AI-assisted practices, and lessons learned from real-world design system work.

## Current availability

Érica is available for remote design systems consulting, contract engagements, workshops, and design system leadership opportunities worldwide.
